properties.description: Core: an accept writes checksum_after and accepted_seq on its CHANGED edge, the next accept takes the next number, re-stating the current acceptance keeps it, going back to earlier content makes that change current again; the export leaves the node checksum and basis off while they equal the current acceptance and the import derives them with nothing counted as materialised (round trip byte-identical); a node checksum the edges do not derive stays on the record; two branches accepting one file leave the Artifact node identical and the union derives a stable pick.
properties.findings:
2026-10-03 (chg:the-design-is-saved-one-file-per-item-2026-10-03): the 4 acceptance tests in the_design_is_saved_one_file_per_item.rs pass.

2026-10-04 (chg:item-layout-lineage-holds-through-a-conflict-resolved-mid-merge-2026-10-04): compare_reads_a_checksum_on_the_node_and_on_its_change_as_one_design: a record written before the move (checksum on the node) and after it (on the change) compare with no node changed and the one CHANGED edge changed; a checksum that really moved still shows. Before the fix, reflow2's own conversion compared as 541 changed artifacts.
properties.name: An accepted checksum is written on the accepting change's edge, numbered, elided from the record while equal, and derived back on import
